reviewer: Independent root reviewer, separate from HL B author
method: Solved all prompts before reading schemes; checked every MCQ distractor, every worked marking point, dimensions, stated assumptions, current level boundaries and all45 native diagrams. Numerical values recomputed independently below.

parts.reasoning: Advance velocity through the three constant-acceleration intervals, then sum their trapezoidal velocity-time areas; acceleration area alone is not displacement.
Equal-height positions locate the projectile vertex halfway between them; the launch point and either other point fix the parabolic scale.
Equal and opposite momenta make the lighter glider three times faster, so its energy is three quarters of the total.
Gravity increases speed between top and bottom; use a different signed radial-force balance at each position after the gravitational energy change.
Delivered water gains both gravitational energy and outlet kinetic energy; divide useful mechanical power by their sum per kilogram.
Both captured lumps add to the disc inertia. Conserved angular momentum halves speed while the increased inertia leaves half the rotational energy.
Emission and return share a location in the clock frame, making that clock interval proper; Earth measures the larger interval by gamma.
checkNames: Earth roundtrip time in L/c units

parts.reasoning: The Earth platform length sets an Earth coordinate interval; the spacecraft clock records the smaller proper interval for its two endpoint passages.
Thermal resistance is inverse area and therefore inverse diameter squared; most temperature drop occurs across the thinner rod.
The off-heater cooling slope fixes the loss at that temperature; adding cooling and warming slope magnitudes isolates total heat capacity.
Only half the atmosphere-absorbed infrared returns downwards. Applying the surface energy balance avoids returning all infrared to the ground.
Equal particle counts give the second vessel four times the first temperature. Energy, total volume and total particle number then fix both final quantities.
Latent heat released by the frozen fraction warms the whole initially supercooled mass to the coexistence temperature; the result is a fraction, not the unfrozen remainder.
Independent subsystem multiplicities multiply, whereas their logarithmic entropies add. Use the final-to-initial multiplicity ratio.
Subtract the hot-reservoir entropy loss from the cold-reservoir entropy gain using rejected heat, which equals input heat minus work.
Opening a branch changes load resistance and cell current because internal resistance remains. Compute load power before taking the ratio.
The acceleration-displacement gradient sets omega squared; the first required speed corresponds to phase pi/3 after release at a turning point.
SHM displacement is measured from equilibrium rather than the unstretched spring length; kinetic energy is the remainder after the squared-displacement potential term.
checkNames: kinetic fraction using displacement from equilibrium

parts.reasoning: Find the critical sine from the sound-speed ratio, then convert cone half-angle and source height into a radius and finally a diameter.
Infer the solid index from its air critical angle, then impose grazing refraction at the actual internal incidence angle to obtain the limiting liquid index.
Allowed bright orders at the envelope zeros are missing. Strictly interior integer orders include the centre once and both sides symmetrically.
The first common noncentral order is the smallest positive integer wavelength match, orders three and two; its sine must still be physically allowed.
Stretching a fixed total string mass reduces linear density. Combining that change with tension and vibrating length differs from assuming fixed density.
Treat reflection as two separately allowed Doppler legs. Subtract original frequency from the reflected frequency using the supplied beat definition.
Local zero field does not imply zero potential. Locate cancellation, add both negative potentials and impose zero total energy at infinity.
checkNames: zero-field point distance from 4M in a units
escape speed squared in GM/a units

parts.reasoning: Use a central spatial baseline with all kilometre and kilojoule conversions; field is the negative gradient of gravitational potential.
The short internal explosion conserves total momentum, not kinetic energy. The moving fragment then loses kinetic energy against the planet potential as it escapes.
The nearby negative rod repels electrons from A into B before separation. The isolated pair retains zero total charge after equal opposite charges are trapped.
An electron lowers its potential energy when moving to higher potential; its kinetic energy increases and speed follows the square root of energy.
The wire field is out of the page. Reverse the positive-charge velocity-cross-field direction for an electron to obtain a force perpendicular to its diagonal velocity.
Doubling angular frequency doubles emf amplitude and quadruples mean resistor power; the duration of a rotation halves, so energy per rotation only doubles.
Opposite wire currents produce additive fields at the midpoint. Field is a sum while inter-wire force depends on the product of the two currents.
checkNames: field ratio for opposed wire currents

parts.reasoning: Count distinct energy differences rather than level pairs, because two transitions share a photon energy; cold ground-state absorption only reaches three higher levels.
Use the supplied nuclear-charge-squared level scaling; the helium-ion four-to-two gap equals the hydrogen two-to-one gap.
At a right-angle scatter the Compton wavelength is added to the incoming wavelength; convert wavelength change to reciprocal photon energy before taking the electron fraction.
Subtract the two photoelectric stopping-potential equations to eliminate work function, then substitute back to recover the fraction of photon energy.
Add the two independently decaying rates before solving. The slower isotope decay factor is the square root of the faster one, giving a quadratic with one physical root.
checkNames: combined normalized rate at that time

parts.reasoning: One-dimensional elastic momentum and relative-speed reversal give a recoiling heavier nucleus; include its mass when converting its speed to an energy fraction.
Radius depends on square-root luminosity and inverse temperature squared. The cool luminous star must be much larger than the hot faint star.
Parallax first supplies the distance ratio, so flux can be converted to luminosity. Equal luminosity then makes radius inversely proportional to temperature squared.
Subtract the negative jaw zero from the repeated mean. The explicitly requested conservative bound adds half-range, resolution and zero-correction contributions.
Use sphere volume in cubic metres and mass in kilograms. Cubing the measured diameter triples its fractional maximum contribution to density uncertainty.
Mass is density times pi D cubed over six, so the gradient determines density after the gram/cubic-centimetre conversion. A constant intercept is a balance offset.
Independent random means may improve with repeats, but a common zero or calibration limitation does not average away. An external calibrated reference addresses that systematic contribution.
Subtract the non-collapsing plateau before taking a dimensionless logarithm. Logarithm of total volume is not linear when a fixed offset remains.
The endpoint excess-volume ratio determines exponential rate and its unit; half-life is ln2 divided by that rate, for excess rather than total volume.
The maximum logarithmic ratio uses high initial volume, low final volume and the same high plateau at both times. Enumerating correlated endpoint corners confirms the maximum.
checkNames: largest common-plateau decay constant, published rounding

parts.reasoning: The fixed central model predicts a lower later volume than measured. Under the stipulated diagnostic comparison the difference challenges extrapolation, without pretending the ignored parameter uncertainty was tested.
Steady uphill force is useful motor power divided by speed. Subtract the along-slope weight and divide by speed squared to isolate drag coefficient; its SI unit is kg per metre.
At the new speed, keep the gravity term fixed, increase quadratic drag and multiply their sum by speed, then divide by motor efficiency.
With the motor disengaged downhill, terminal speed balances along-slope weight against opposing quadratic resistance.
checkNames: downhill terminal speed m/s, published rounding

parts.reasoning: Only when quadratic resistance dominates does required mechanical power become proportional to speed cubed; unchanged efficiency then makes an eightfold input produce twice the speed.
Use circular centripetal acceleration and convert the six-hour period to seconds before solving for central mass.
Both final orbits are circular about the same fixed mass; the period ratio follows radius to the three-halves power.
The potential becomes less negative outward. Divide its positive change by radial separation for the specified mean magnitude, while the actual field points inward.
Factor the reciprocal-radius difference to show the mean field is GM divided by the product of the two radii, then equate to local inverse-square field.
Equal time steps require equal ratios after subtracting one common background; the three measurements determine that offset and show a half per three-day interval.
Convert half-life to seconds, correct recorded counts per minute for efficiency, then use activity equals decay constant times parent number.
After three half-lives seven eighths have become stable daughters. Every decay emits the same total gamma energy even when split into a cascade.
checkNames: daughter nuclei at 9 days, published rounding
total gamma energy J, published rounding

parts.reasoning: Three allowed nuclear levels suffice: total upper gap550keV and one intermediate level210 or340keV. Both cascade gaps and the direct gap match the listed discrete photons.
Equal heat capacities and no extracted work in direct contact make the common temperature the arithmetic mean.
Apply the supplied logarithmic entropy relation to each block. The positive total reflects irreversible heat flow through a finite temperature difference.
A reversible cyclic engine produces no total entropy; the supplied relation gives the geometric-mean final temperature. The internal-energy decrease then equals external work.
Cooling both blocks to300K with no compensating change decreases total entropy, so a first-law energy balance alone cannot permit the proposed full work conversion.
The approaching onboard source first shifts wall frequency; the approaching onboard receiver then shifts the reflected frequency. Solving their product retains both denominators correctly.
The two reflected legs have total length1.50m versus1.20m directly. With the stated zero reflection phase, the lowest destructive condition is a half-wavelength path difference.
Measure incidence from the normal, not the surface. The required transmitted sine exceeds one because incidence exceeds the speed-ratio critical angle.
Within the specified nondispersive model, frequency does not change either sound speed or their critical-angle ratio, so frequency alone cannot restore propagation.
Equal electric and magnetic forces select E/B speed. The downward electric force requires an upward magnetic force on positive ions moving right, hence into-page selector field.
The accelerating voltage sets kinetic energy, while the selector fixes speed; combine these to infer mass and compare with one atomic mass unit.
The magnetic-only analyser gives radius mv over qB. The detector offset after a semicircle is a diameter, directed above the entry for the stated field.

A heavier same-charge isotope is slower at the same accelerating voltage. Its reduced upward magnetic force cannot balance the unchanged downward electric force, so it bends toward the negative plate.
The negative squared spacetime interval identifies a spacelike separation and is not a negative time duration.
Use the supplied Lorentz transformation with positive frame speed. Q has negative primed ct while P remains at the shared origin, so Q occurs first.
Set transformed time separation to zero to infer the new frame speed. Invariance then gives the simultaneous spatial separation directly.
The event separation would require a signal faster than light. Independent spacelike events may reverse coordinate order without changing a realizable causal chain.
Invert blackbody luminosity to recover surface area and radius using Kelvin temperature.
Apply hydrogen fraction, accessible fraction and mass-to-energy efficiency in order. Only the non-neutrino share supplies the observed luminosity; divide that budget by luminosity and convert years.
Each fusion chain supplies only its stated non-neutrino photon share to luminosity, so the chain rate uses that smaller energy per event.
checkNames: fusion chains per second, published rounding

parts.reasoning: All escaping photons and neutrinos reduce stellar mass at total escaping power over c squared. Enhanced fusion tends to expand/cool the core, reducing the fusion rate as negative feedback.
checkNames: radiative and neutrino mass-loss rate kg/s

parts.reasoning: The undamped mass-spring period and angular frequency set maximum initial speed at the known amplitude.
Faraday induction uses the gradient of flux linkage along translation, multiplied by instantaneous speed; the maximum occurs at maximum speed.
Resistor heating equals the loss of mechanical power, requiring an opposing velocity-proportional force. The coefficient is the squared flux-gradient coupling divided by circuit resistance.
Energy scales as amplitude squared, so the supplied exponential envelope doubles its exponent for energy. Open-circuit current and heating vanish, while an induced emf can remain.
